when canonical draft point/detail/explanationEvidenceRefs are empty, overlay_special fills them from SPECIAL audit point/detail/evidenceRefs

staticCanonicalIngestionProof.localExecutionAttempt: latest main cloneによる独立実行も試みたが、実行環境のDNSでgithub.comを解決できなかったため同手法を反復せず静的照合へ変更した。

canonicalIngestion.mechanism: build_general_canonical.py reads K113-SPECIAL-AUDIT.json and overlays missing point/detail/evidence onto the consolidated general records. The five repaired sourceDataDefects remain historical audit records but are automatically removed from active quarantine when sourceCorrectionStatus=official_pdf_verified.
coordinatorActionReducedTo: run existing workflow on current main

evidenceRepair.note: 味蕾・片麻痺移乗・歩行補助具へ誤対応していた旧参照を、各問題の実内容に一致する根拠へ差し替えた。

nextLoop: Coordinator runs the existing general canonical workflow against current main. B-general final canonical PASS may be declared only after actual consolidated canonical audits return integrityExit=0, sharedAuditExit=0, exam113 missingExplanation=0 and missingEvidence=0; media/content/scoring release gates remain separate.
